# API reference

This reference lists every public C++ type and enumeration declared under `include/gui_forms/`, grouped by purpose. Stock controls are grouped the way the [controls index](../controls/index.md) groups them; the rest of the library is grouped by area.

Each entry shows the header to include, the declaration, a reviewed description where one exists, and the public members. Descriptions are written and reviewed by hand; a member listed without a description has none yet. 2049 of 3208 members are described.
